messages:
devin: Quick microbench: compared q5 vs q8 across chat / embeddings / rerank on p4dn-like nodes. Sharing raw numbers and a few notes, want product/GTN routing guidance.

bench-bot: Results CSV: workload,model,quant,median_latency_ms,p95_latency_ms,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1M_tokens,quality_delta
```
chat,redwood-13b,q5,110,190,280,28,-0.8%
chat,redwood-13b,q8,86,145,360,42,0.0%
embed,redwood-embed,q5,30,48,1200,9,-0.6%
embed,redwood-embed,q8,26,40,1500,13,0.0%
rerank,redwood-rank,q5,60,110,600,14,-1.5%
rerank,redwood-rank,q8,48,82,780,20,0.0%
```

maria: Nice table. A couple of clarifying q's: how was quality_delta measured? small eval holdout?

devin: Yes — 10k sample holdout per workload. chat = multi-turn instruction-following score (0-100), embed = downstream retrieval MRR, rerank = nDCG@5. Numbers are % change vs q8 baseline.

anita: So q5 saves ~33% cost but loses up to 1.5% quality on rerank. Is that perceptible in prod? :thinking: 

maria: For embeddings a 0.6% MRR drop might be fine for bulk offline embed jobs, but not for retrieval-first search features.

josh: Product question: if GTN wants a single routing policy, what's the recommended default? Keep in mind latency SLOs for chat are 150ms p95.

talia: From product/GTN POV: prefer safe defaults — minimize user-facing regressions. Suggest default routing: chat -> q8; embeddings -> q5; rerank -> conditional (q8 for top-k sensitive queries, else q5). Provide an escape hatch flag for cost-tier.

devin: Proposed implementation plan:
- add routing flag `quant_tier` with values [q8, q5, hybrid]
- hybrid uses a heuristics table: if prompt_length<64 && feature == "rerank" -> q8, else q5
- add eval gates (auto-eval on canary) to detect regressions >0.5% MRR or >1% nDCG -> block rollout

bench-bot: Example config snippet:
```
route:
  model: redwood-13b
  quant_tier: hybrid
  heuristics:
    rerank:
      prompt_len_threshold: 64
      prefer: q8
    default: q5
```

maria: Love the eval gate thresholds. Can we also record unit econ delta per route in the console (tokens->$)?

devin: Yep — will add per-route token_econ to console telemetry and a dashboard.

josh: One more ask from GTN: include recommended rollout cadence and rollback criteria. Maybe canary -> 1h -> 6h -> 24h with quality checks and cost validation.

talia: Agreed. Also include messaging for sales: "we can tailor quant routing per feature to balance cost and quality".

devin: Action items:
- I will open an RFC + PR for `quant_tier` config and heuristics (ETA EOW)
- bench-bot will attach full CSV + eval scripts to the RFC
- @talia if that covers GTN messaging we can sync for release notes

talia: yes pls ping me on the RFC. thanks!

maria: Thanks all. Small follow-up: tag ops for autoscale implications (q8 higher throughput -> autoscaler thresholds?)

devin: will loop in @ops in the RFC. closing the loop here :white_check_mark:
